articles.title: Ancient Rock Cores Reveal Oxygen Was Key to Complex Life
articles.summary: Scientists studying 1.7-billion-year-old fossils in Australia found that early complex life only lived where oxygen was present. The discovery helps explain how all animals — including us — came to exist.

articles.title: Quantum Simulator Recreates Matter 'Popping Into Existence'
articles.summary: Using a trapped-ion quantum computer, scientists simulated string breaking — a process where pulling particles apart creates new ones. The experiment could help unlock the deepest mysteries of matter.

articles.title: Cosmic 'Fart' Explains Why a Zombie Star Keeps Flashing Earth
articles.summary: A neutron star 13,000 light-years away flares with X-rays every time it passes through a giant plume of gas from its giant partner star. New observations finally explain the mysterious flashes.
